description: With only a cache disk, mergerfs would have no branch: the command exits with 1 and prints nothing.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[placement]
min_free = ["1GiB"]
[[disk]]
id = "c1"
uuid = "5f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/c1"
fs = "ext4"
role = "cache"
